name: Card Grading Tracker (CGT)
summary: Entire hockey/baseball/football backlog fully priced via a 7-agent parallel research sweep. Standing rule: every card gets individually researched, missing grade tiers get a labeled comp-based estimate rather than being left blank. Grading service tiers reference kept current through 9/17 (PSA tier reorg 9/14, Beckett outage, SGC price hike).
